visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: The Boundary Mark Misses the Grade
visualizerParams.problemDescription: 90 marks should earn an A, but the program gives it a B.

solution.explanation: A grade boundary belongs to the higher grade, so the comparison must include the boundary value itself: >= 90. With > 90 exactly 90 marks falls through to the next branch. Always test the exact boundary values.
